## Website disclaimer

The information provided by Unleashed Potential Psychotherapy ("we," "us," or "our") on https://uptherapygroup.com (the "Site") is for general informational purposes only. All information on the Site is provided in good faith. However, we make no representation or warranty of any kind, express or implied, about the accuracy, adequacy, validity, reliability, availability or completeness of any information on the Site.

Under no circumstance shall we have any liability to you for any loss or damage of any kind incurred as a result of the use of the Site or reliance on any information provided on the Site. Your use of the Site and your reliance on any information on the Site is solely at your own risk.

## Professional disclaimer

The Site does not provide psychotherapy, counseling, medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. The mental health information on the Site is provided for general informational and educational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional care from a licensed provider who knows your situation.

Reading the Site, sending a message or requesting a consultation does not create a therapist-client relationship. That relationship begins only after an intake is complete and both parties agree to work together.

Before you take any action based on information on the Site, we encourage you to speak with an appropriate licensed professional.

## In a crisis

The Site is not an emergency service, and messages sent through it are not monitored around the clock. If you are in crisis or in danger, call or text **988** (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), call **911**, or go to the nearest emergency room.

## Testimonial disclaimer

The Site may contain reviews and testimonials from clients. These reflect the real experiences and opinions of those clients. However, each experience is personal, and it may not represent the experience of every client. We do not claim, and you should not assume, that every client will have the same experience. Individual results vary.

Reviews are submitted in writing and are reviewed by us before they are posted. They appear as written, except for the correction of grammar or typing errors. Some reviews are shortened where the full text held details not relevant to the public. Names are shortened to protect each client's privacy.

The views and opinions in the reviews belong to the individual client and do not necessarily reflect our views. Clients are not paid or otherwise compensated for their reviews.

## External links

The Site may contain links to other websites, such as podcasts, articles and booking tools. We do not control these websites and are not responsible for their content, accuracy or privacy practices.
